Guacamole For One
By: Anonymous
Published: Tuesday, December 15, 2009 - 11:58pm

Ingredients




1 small ripe avocado, peeled and pitted
1 small tomato, seeded and finely chopped
1 small garlic clove, crushed
1 tablespoon (15 ml) finely chopped onion
1 teaspoon (5 ml) lemon or lime juice
Hot sauce to taste
Salt and freshly ground pepper to taste

Preparation

1 Mash the avocado with a fork in a small bowl. Stir in the remaining ingredients. Serve with tortilla chips. 2 Serves 1.
